selection_rule: Expand before any selected-block RESULT access to create a minimal cross-circumference transport/design pilot; expansion is source/design driven, not outcome driven.

selected_blocks.meeting_name: みちのく記念　善知鳥杯争奪戦

selected_blocks.official_schedule_source: KEIRIN.JP multiple current rider scheduled-appearance records; monthly schedule corroboration

design_note.reason: 333m level is represented by only one venue in this pilot and remains confounded with 富山 venue identity; this block can test transport and expose a contrast, not establish generalized circumference affinity.
design_note.required_later: Prospectively add at least one additional independent 333m venue block before any generalized circumference-affinity claim; preferably broader multi-venue/time coverage.

population_freeze_rules: Do not remove races because of outcomes, model errors, line complexity, missing desired signal, or venue behavior.
Transport/source failures remain explicit UNKNOWN/TIMING_UNSAFE and are never silently dropped.
Exact race IDs and active fields may be appended only from PRE-event capture before each race cutoff.
If race start or PRE timestamp safety cannot be proven, do not reconstruct after the event.
No RESULT, PAYOUT, odds, human forecast, marks/comments/tips, provider narabiyoso, or candidate output may define membership.
No further venue expansion after viewing any selected-block RESULT unless the expanded population is a separately named future prespecified phase and prior blocks are treated as burned for selection.
